about_the_game: Immerse yourself in the deep, reverberating caverns of CleanFall, and enjoy a broad array of atmospheric music. CleanFall's music was composed on a small, budget laptop in a college dorm by Ethan Brown after years of studying piano and music theory. Despite the technical limitations surrounding its production, the soundtrack contains a broad plethora of genres and instruments. From strings, brass, and chants, to dubstep, lo-fi, and trap, CleanFall's music will lead the listener to all sorts of strange places.

name: CleanFall Soundtrack
short_description: CleanFall's soundtrack focuses on atmosphere and originality. It contains a mixture of deep, powerful synths, orchestral swells, and various strange sound effects. While the soundtrack repeats certain stylistic choice, most songs are very unique when compared to the rest of the soundtrack.
